integrity: All algebraic identities used in the proof were reconstructed from the displayed reduced Jacobian and replayed with exact symbolic arithmetic. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the positive derivative slice fixed by the source's graph automorphism. It proves a local spectral classification only and does not resolve the general sixteen-parameter conjecture or the nonlinear zero-eigenvalue bifurcation.
title: Exact stability dichotomy on the symmetry-fixed dual futile-cycle Jacobian
